title: Offline bounded performance and reliability qualification harness

bindings.adapter: identity and version digest from the adapter contract
bindings.supervisor: session, worker, lease, and expiry from the supervisor admission
bindings.journal: session and chain-head digest from the event journal
bindings.observation: every metric and chaos observation repeats all bindings

state_machine.interruption: supplied observation only; no process is interrupted
state_machine.recovery: must identify a bounded recovered or blocked outcome

privacy.projection: identities, bounded values, units, dispositions, counts, and digests only

failure_semantics.side_effects: no provider, network, LLM, process, host, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, Git, or durable-state operation

limitations: The harness checks deterministic supplied observations and does not measure a real workload.
A qualified fixture is not provider, host, production, hosted-CI, or remote execution evidence.
Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, and UI remain authoritative; the runtime cannot manufacture their decisions.
follow_up: AWQ must independently accept any evidence before live integration.
A future approved integration AR must provide Coordinator lease, host enforcement, credential, network, and human-approval evidence.
AWG decides material workload or failure-taxonomy alternatives; UI handles any human gate.
